newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on blender demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on blender demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose slightly despite the absence of major overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Local blenders and export buyers lent effective support to the market, pushing prices up. Poland, the only foreign buyer at the auction, lifted a small quantity of bold and large broken teas.

More than 1.2 million kg were sold at the auction. The average price was 44.1 taka, up 0.29 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on October 8 with an offer of 1.31 million kg. ($1.0 = 42.45) --Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
